text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm planning a staggered cutover for runtime v2.3.1 + router header split tonight 23:00 UTC. Need API + Console pinned during wave2. @sam @nora please ack.

deploy-bot: scheduled wave=2 start=1727227000, strategy=staggered(25%/25%/50%). pinned_variants: runtime:v2.3.1, router:header-split-v1. Fallback variant: runtime:v2.3.0

sam: Ack. I'll hold the API pin and keep a light traffic mirror during the first 30m. Adding health-checks: /v1/healthz and /v1/predict sample 50rps.

nora: Console will be pinned. I can pause feature flags that touch session tracing if we see KV thrash.

liam: On-call for runtime tonight. Rollback trigger we agreed: error-rate > 2% sustained over 5m OR p95 latency increase > 300ms vs baseline for 10m. If triggered, rollback to runtime:v2.3.0 and router header toggle off.

alex: Adding quick runbook snippet in thread:
```
# rollback
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to v2.3.0 --reason "auto-trigger"
deploybot rollback --service router --variant header-split-v1 --disable
# emergency route
kubectl patch svc router -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"v2.3.0"}}}'
```

maya: Release notes live: https://go/release/1727 (short list: kernel batching, kv eviction tuning, router header split). QA smoke passed in staging, but watch evictions metric: runtime.kv.evictions/sec.

sam: Will stream p95/p99 and evictions to #release-metrics. If evictions > 10/s for 5m we throttle traffic and consider rollback.

nora: Console telemetry might spike; if traces drop below 80% sampling we flag. I'll watch tracing drop and session errors.

liam: If rollback required, call the handoff: @maya lead rollback, @sam API unpin, @nora console unpin, I execute deploybot commands. We'll meet in 5m if things look marginal.

maya: Cool. I'll post a short note to #release-ops at 22:45 UTC to remind teams. :thumbsup:

alex: Quick check — do we need a short canary warmup script? I can run `smoke-canary.sh --warmup 10m` before traffic shift.

sam: Yes, please run warmup. Start warmup at t-6m before wave start.

deploy-bot: note: watch window configured: quiet-window 22:50-23:40 UTC. Alerts routed to: pager oncall(liam). Good luck :rocket:

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release doc if anything changes.
